content:
Hello! I have been using lean4-mode for emacs for the last month now, and I have been enjoying it so far. I have only been using emacs for a year, so I still don't know a lot about elisp (or any kind of lisp). I tried going through the code for lean4-mode to understand how it worked and add the following features, but I have yet to make any progress. Here is what I would like to do:

  • make the apply button in the infoview work the way it does in vscode (with regard to simp? for example)
  • more easily customize pretty-printing in infoview
  • stop watching files for changes (this makes my computer fan turn on, scary)
  • show more information about tactics when hovering over them (currently shows up at the bottom of the screen, but only the first line of the description is displayed.)

I will post updates here if I figure any of this out. Any tips are appreciated, thank you.

Cool! My (E)Lisp is also too non-existant to help with any of that, but I just remembered that Eshel Yaron wrote about how to get hover-info in emacs here: https://eshelyaron.com/posts/2025-02-11-hover-for-help-in-emacs-lisp.html - though he only shows it working for lisp code, not Lean :thinking:

Yes, but I only need it in the infoview.

Also, I want to elaborate on the pretty-printing: I realized this morning that I want to copy things in the pretty printer and paste them back into my code (this is useful at times). Ideally this would be an optional feature, toggle-able. I do not need this feature, but if there was an easy way to implement this I would be interested to learn :)
That's beyond my level of expertise in emacs. But seems the information is available. Maybe there some way of putting it in a buffer somehow?
I know that there are linters that can be toggled for pretty printing, but I dont have a good grasp of them yet. I will ask about the pretty printing in another channel.

Jeremiah Hockaday said:

  • stop watching files for changes (this makes my computer fan turn on, scary)

For the stock lsp-mode-based version of lean4-mode, customize lsp-enable-file-watchers to nil using M-x customize-variable RET. (This is an lsp-mode setting, not specific to lean4-mode.)
